rationale: The theft is a covered Baggage and Personal Effects claim under wording section 5 and manual section 7 (theft from the person is never unattended), and the incident and filing fall within the trip and the 90-day window. Two required documents are missing: the Carabinieri police report (manual section 5, which must be made within 24 hours) and proof of value for the $130 sunglasses (over $100). Refer to a claims handler to send a document request for both, with the customer given 30 days. If they arrive in order, the payout is $420: backpack $90, tablet $150 and rain jacket $150 at the Economy per-item limit, sunglasses $130, less the $100 deductible (wording sections 1 and 10, manual section 6, manual version 2026.2).
